changes.title: Trump delivers $10 million to Ken Paxton in first major contribution of midterms
changes.summary: President Trump's MAGA Inc. super PAC had previously only given one donation this midterm cycle: about $800,000 to Darline Graham.

changes.title: Trump’s Super PAC Will Spend $10 Million on Texas Senate Race
changes.summary: A financial filing announcing the TV and digital ad buy is the first general election spending by MAGA Inc. The group intends to boost the Republican nominee, Ken Paxton.

changes.title: Texas Attorney General investigates military healthcare contractor TriWest
changes.summary: Following a report for the series “The Cost of Denial,” Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton announced an investigation into the company at the center of the Nightly News story. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports.

changes.title: Dark money in Texas Senate race spurs Talarico complaint to FEC against Paxton
changes.summary: James Talarico's Senate campaign is accusing Ken Paxton and his campaign treasurer of "illegally spending" $1 million that was routed to a Paxton-aligned super PAC.

changes.title: Trump may need to save Paxton in Texas Senate race
changes.summary: The News Republicans are counting on President Donald Trump’s cavalry to carry Ken Paxton to victory — but it hasn’t come yet.
